notes.title: Lucifer Within Us 1.0.4
notes.content:
Greetings digital exorcists, we thank you for all your help in daemon-purging. On this day we bring to you update 1.0.4 in order to aid you better in your endeavours.


 Mac build made more stable
 Pressing space bar no longer continues dialogue or un-pause testimony during pause menu
 Replies to asking about psychological evidence of other suspects has been changed from "I don't see how this proves me wrong" to "I don't know anything about this." in English and French
 Voiceovers now always correspond to the correct dialogue line
 Various typo fixes


Spread the word! Regale the world with tales of your purging! Tell your friends (and even your enemies) about Lucifer Within Us!

With reverence,
Inquisitor Fiona and the Church of Kitfox

notes.title: Lucifer Within Us 1.0.2: Now in русский язык!
notes.content:
Thank you, exorcists for almost a month of daemon-purging. We are blessed to bring you improvements to your professional workflow, including the following, for version 1.0.2:

- Added Russian localization! 
- French localization now matches its voice acting in all cases
- Added new case-specific art on loading screens
- We optimized some scripts for improved performance
- Ask button now appears at center of each timeline box
- Fixed a crash happening due to il2cpp not being supported
- Interaction arrow on first dialogue will no longer remain longer than intended
- VFX will now pause when testimony is paused
- Screen shake no longer persists to the main menu

May your sins be minor and your repentance sincere.

Ain Soph be with you,
Tanya & the Kitfox team

notes.title: Next week. ☠️ Lucifer Within Us is coming Oct 15
notes.content:
Hello, digital exorcists.

It's almost here. Almost here. We are preparing our scriptures, tightening up our technologies, and studying our theology in preparation for the release next week on Oct 15th, 12pm ET. It is the perfect month for it, after all.

Wishlist the game to ensure your place among the Church.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/a0f1387435d3961df9569aa16ff4ce39f05db15f.png

What can I do?
While we await the rise of a New World, you may help the Inquisition through encouraging friends, families, and fellow daemons to check out the game themselves.

Next week, as thanks for your presence here, we shall be sending out a spoiler-free guide to navigate the game, as well as peeks of the art.

A new demo will be available now as part of the Steam Fall Festival (Oct 7 - 13). We have taken your feedback from previous times and polished many things behind it. Your dedication to the investigations are appreciated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/aec931ab3df6bca10b057c2c327a688fda44a4bd.png

In addition, we'll be streaming the game on the Steam page directly at various times We hope to see you there.

Soon, we will purge daemons from suspect minds. For now, you may find us on Twitter or Discord.

With reverence,

Inquisitor Victoria

notes.title: Finishing touches & the demo returns
notes.content:
Hello, digital exorcists.

We are less than a month away from the game's release on October 15th. Here is the final update before the big announcement... prepare your technology, or face consequences afterwards.

Wishlist the game to ensure you are notified when it releases.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/90b2cd46a71cbed6efd66b8ec6b8f77b6a4fe531.png

Game Devs of Color Expo

The game's demo will be back for a limited time (Sept 18 - 21) as part of GDoC Expo. With many other demos, talks, and other activities, this is one of our favorite events of the year. 

Will you be able to discover the murderer and cast out their daemons, exorcist? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/ff150ad03e8b3c6542821f32db983a0ad0153fc4.png

Dev Updates

Finishing touches for the game have been the focus of this month's work.


 Art polish over one of the murder cases. VFX for murder sequences including blood, gore and cool visual effects (dust particles, electric shocks, cloud shadows, etc.)
 2D polish of UI elements, some revamping of UX
 Tech optimization and bug fixing, localization


Soon, we will be united with the other world. For now, you may find us on Twitter or Discord. Please remember to wishlist the game, should you desire it once it releases.

With reverence,

Inquisitor Victoria

notes.title: First Playable Demo at PAX East 2020.
notes.content:
The second month of the year has already come for us, and our technologies are rushing to keep up with the onslaught of daemon possessions.

We are under oath to let you know of this event though: at PAX East, come by the Kitfox Games booth (#27039) to play the first ever public demo of Lucifer Within Us. We hope to see you there, exorcists.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/ad34fdeedf4ae7a325479eb011725d3ed2c76464.png

Development
The environmental art of the Final Case of the game is complete, as well as the character portraits. Exorcist Ada, whom you will be controlling, is under your care. We have also updated the tech to allow for localization for different tongues, though if this will help you with the lying suspects is another question.

We grow ever closer to the game's completion, which will allow you to finally solve the murders and exorcise the daemons that plague our world. Your colleague, Inqusitor Vergil, is excited to have you working with him.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/b34b3c35ba11a8273dfc33f772246c847dd3522a.gif

That concludes this month's declaration from the Church of Ein Soph. May you stay safe until our next correspondence...

If you are in need of aid, we may connect in the digital sphere of Discord or Twitter.
Praise,

Inquisitor Victoria and the Church of Kitfox

notes.title: Theory Crafting & A Demo At PAX East ☠️
notes.content:
Hello, exorcists.

We begin the new decade deep in our technologies - are we possessed by daemons to complete our tasks? We cannot say. Perhaps an exorcist will be knocking on our doors soon...

D̷̡̍̋̚e̵̪̣̪͑͂͘ṽ̸̫̝̤̏͠ȩ̶͍͛̆l̶̻͈̱̹̈́̑͝o̴̼̊p̸̛̓̉͘ͅm̵̰͇̼̔̎͗͊e̸̹̱͑ņ̸̣̻̏̒́́ṭ̴̞̤̊͗̈́̔ͅ
Much of the game's story arc has been completed, and the cases are all undergoing a polish round. Soon you will discover the mysteries of Ein Soph... unless, of course, you fall under possession yourself. Luckily, the technology has been updated in order to allow you to save and load cases across the game, with large improvements to the user interface so that there is more of a focus on the mystery solving. Along with new animations and 3D production on the final case, the Church's completion draws ever closer... Of course, we have also done the ritual exorcism to rid of as many bugs as possible.

This is a very work-in-progress example of the means in which your accusations will be articulated, after a suspect questions you about your accusation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/1b7e7c305b020357157579b4e87a78b7dbe6bcb5.png

Practice your skills, exorcist. We do not want any false truths...

If you are curious as to how the game looks, you may find that we presented this game at a local event called DemoNight. (Which looks suspiciously like "Demon"... uh, "ight".) You may view the recording here, on the digital sphere of Twitch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/937964f6fbe029bcf68eaa677f3aeac286fca3fb.gif

If this has assured your confidence in The Church, you will be able to play the first ever public demo of the game at PAX East 2020. Please make sure you come by to solve the murders... or else, who will?

If not, we shall connect in the digital sphere of Discord or Twitter. Or if you prefer electronic correspondence, via newsletter.

Praise,
Inquisitor Victoria and the Church of Kitfox

notes.title: Welcome, exorcists.
notes.content:
I, Victoria, am your humble servant and guide in this New World. As a part of the Church of Ain Soph's Inquisition, we depend on our exorcists to purge those who are infected. 

I will strive to keep you updated on the progress of this game, but cannot promise I myself will not be possessed by daemons.

Our development.
Trust that these reports contain no lies - no daemons have infiltrated these hallowed servers... yet.

Let us first remind you of your role. In this New World, you are a digital exorcist. A unique timeline skill you have obtained shows a suspect's subjective retelling of the events. Use this to find contradictions, find the possessed, and solve the murders.

Remember to wishlist this on Steam, to appease the algorithm daemons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/2ac6dad24e44a89eee7d7daada9e58b4ba53e789.png

At the Church of Kitfox, most recently much of our efforts have gone into the completion of the first and second mystery case. Specific musical tracks for each witness during their testimonies have been created. There have been many improvements to the exorcism systems and environment, including the addition of futuristic tech props, overgrown vegetation (to make structures blend more), and footprints. Yes, characters will now have muddy footprints when the rain starts, which will be useful if one of them should commit a murder...

Day and night cycles are also being worked on, which you can peep at here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/f4c272f5884f777be4a388b4939e7dd95d278273.jpg

If not, we shall connect in the digital sphere of Discord, Twitter, or our newsletter, for more specific updates.

Praise,

Inquisitor Victoria and the Church of Kitfox
